integrity: All nine factors have a finite substitution-block completeness proof; all intransitive block stabilizers and conjugates of the five proper transitive group types are enumerated by a standard-library verifier; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only at factor length seven; uses the established classification of transitive degree-seven permutation groups; does not classify all lengths or settle the global open question.
title: The complete seven-coordinate group-complexity spectrum of a ternary Fibonacci image
